label: Bold and energetic
summary: No timid, passive hedges or apologetic hesitation
writing_style: High-energy, forward-moving sentences with punchy calls to action and confident declarations.
messaging_principles: Inspire action and highlight bold achievements while maintaining truthful claims.

rules.title: Avoid Timid Hesitation & Over-Hedged Passivity
rules.description: Bold communications replace apologetic, timid hedges with confident, active statements.

suggested_replacements.apologies for existing: we are thrilled to partner with you

rules.do_example: Build the future of your brand with bold confidence.
rules.dont_example: We might somewhat humbly suggest that perhaps maybe you could consider our tools.

terminology.notes: Inspire proactive confidence rather than timid hesitation.
